# HorizontalAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines horizontal alignment within an available layout region.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new HorizontalAlignment()
```

## Properties

- [`Center`](#center): Align to the center
- [`End`](#end): Align to the end (right for LTR languages)
- [`Left`](#left): Physical left edge, independent of direction.
- [`Right`](#right): Physical right edge, independent of direction.
- [`Start`](#start): Inline start: left in LTR, right in RTL.
- [`Stretch`](#stretch): Stretch to fill available space
